title: The Workflow Step That Runs the Script
description: A short workflow step that orchestrates the deploy script and passes the token and Worker name from GitHub.

steps.description: This is the workflow step that runs the deploy. It is short because the logic lives in `deploy.sh`.
The step runs `./deploy.sh`. The workflow orchestrates; the script does the work.
`CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` comes from GitHub's secrets and is masked in the logs.
`WORKER_NAME` is a plain variable, not a secret.
